text:
ben_w: hey folks — i pushed updates addressing the review comments from yesterday. split the changes into two commits (impl + tests), fixed the retry semantics, and added a smoke script. CI is green. PTAL when you have a sec

maria_g: thanks ben. quick Q — did you change the default backoff value? i remember we discussed not touching that if possible

ben_w: yep changed default -> 200ms (was 500ms). added unit test and an explanatory comment in retry.go. keeping it conservative but should help tail latency on short requests

sam_k: ran the smoke locally, exercised the new path. overall looks good. one small nit: the log for failed attempts is using Info, should be Debug to avoid alert noise

ben_w: good catch — swapped to Debug and removed a stray fmt.Printf. pushed force-update to the second commit (kept history split for easier review)

ci-bot: build #4321 — all checks passed (unit, lint, integration). artifacts: https://ci.internal/4321 :white_check_mark:

merge-ops: ping @ben_w — we have a 15:30 PST canary slot today. can you confirm you'll merge + deploy then if all looks good?

ben_w: i can make the window. plan: after final thumbs i'll squash commits, tag with changelog entry, and hit merge shortly before 15:30. will watch canary and roll back if any regressions show up. PTAL for final ok

maria_g: :thumbsup: LGTM from me

sam_k: LGTM — approve. i gave a small inline suggestion but it's optional

ben_w: thanks! added the changelog snippet to CHANGES.md:

```
Fix: reduce default retry backoff from 500ms to 200ms to improve tail latency for short inference requests (maria_g, sam_k review)
```
\nben_w: squashed and pushed merge-ready branch. will merge at canary window unless anyone objects

merge-ops: noted. please include the canary notes in the deployment ticket — i added a slot and test checklist.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for commit abc123def (user: ben_w). status: in-progress.

ben_w: monitoring logs and perf dashboards now. no errors in the first 10 mins. will keep thread updated and cut release if stable.

deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded. rollout to stable scheduled in 30m unless rollback requested.

ben_w: merging and closing out. thanks everyone for quick reviews!
